description: This Java class configures OpenAPI 3.x metadata and server settings for the BankApp REST API. It uses annotations from the 'io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations' package to define API info, contact, license, and server URL details, which are automatically processed by springdoc-openapi to generate API documentation.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up OpenAPI metadata and server details for the BankApp API.
